defects.quote: WHEN a guest is added to a booking, the system SHALL create a guest account for their email
defects.description: Creating an account for a guest contradicts the brief, which says people who are not members of the club, such as guests, never get an account and only people an admin invited have one.

defects.quote: address is on fewer than 3 other bookings that start in the same calendar month.
defects.description: The monthly limit only states and tests the accepted side (a third visit); no rule says what happens when the guest is already on 3 bookings that month (refuse? warn?), and there is no scenario just over the limit.
